subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Should Feishu group-session keys become account/app-scoped for all group scopes, and what migration or doctor behavior should existing shared group sessions receive?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but changing durable session identity affects transcript continuity, last-route account metadata, and cross-bot authorization boundaries, so automation should not choose the compatibility/security policy alone.

options.title: Account-scope with migration
options.body: Update Feishu group peer/session identity to include account or app identity and provide tested migration or doctor handling for existing shared group sessions.

options.title: Opt-in account-scoped mode
options.body: Add an explicit compatibility-preserving mode first, keeping current shared group sessions as default until maintainers are ready to migrate users.

options.title: Document unsupported multi-bot grouping
options.body: Keep shared group sessions and document that multiple Feishu apps in one group are not isolated, accepting the current safety and UX limitations.

recommendation.title: Account-scope with migration
recommendation.body: Update Feishu group peer/session identity to include account or app identity and provide tested migration or doctor handling for existing shared group sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: The plugin metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark community maintainer, while the decision is Feishu-specific and crosses session/security boundaries.
